title: Gatchalian pushes OK of bill barring public execs’ kin from gov't deals

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian urged Congress to immediately pass a proposed measure prohibiting government officials’ relatives from securing government contracts to protect public funds and prevent corruption. “It is important that we enact this as soon as possible so that we can ensure that public funds go to programs and projects that will help the people and not just the relatives of those in power,” said Gatchalian, referring to Senate Bill 1962, or the Government Contracting and Procurement Integrity Act, which he co-authored. The Senate recently approved the proposed bill on third and final reading. It is expected to […]... Keep on reading: Gatchalian pushes OK of bill barring public execs’ kin from gov't deals
